summary: Collective Mining Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a news release dated October 13, 2026, reporting drill assay results from the Shallow Halo Zone at its Apollo Deposit, Guayabales Project, Colombia. Highlights include 87.60m at 158 g/t AgEq from 17.70m, including 5.50m at 1,999 g/t AgEq (1,283 g/t Ag, 0.83% WO3) in hole APC-186, plus broad shallow intervals in APC-193 and APC-184. Twenty-two of 23 SHZ holes returned mineralization within the pit shell; the adit is set to begin in Q4 2026. This is a routine exploration update, not a special situation.
